_comment: Known terminal defaults, verified from the linked upstream documentation and keymap sources.
Matching is case-insensitive, at a terminal-name boundary. Multiplexer identities retain outer terminal conflicts.
Terminal-specific rendering capabilities live beside shortcut conflicts; protocol-detected capabilities remain runtime facts.
Only Ctrl/Shift chords representable by KeyCombo are listed. Platform-specific rows use Rust target OS names.
These are conservative conflict profiles, not a probe of customized terminal or desktop bindings.
legacy_input lists decoder/encoding limitations and received-key translations, not terminal-owned shortcuts; these do not apply to native console or negotiated enhanced input.
VTE alone does not identify its hosting application; its profile conservatively covers GNOME defaults.
generic marks a name that identifies no single emulator. A profile pinned over it is not reported as a mismatch.
Native Windows Console uses raw console input. Unknown terminals use transport-safe Studio defaults.
